key_insight: Trust Guided Decision Transformer (TGDT) improves long-horizon Decision Transformer rollouts by using the model’s own next-state prediction error as a trust signal. This helps identify when the context has drifted out of distribution and choose a more reliable context before applying value guidance.
problem_solved: Decision Transformers can degrade during long rollouts because their conditioning context drifts away from the training distribution, making guidance increasingly unreliable.
method: Measure next-state prediction error during rollout as an online proxy for context reliability.
Select among recent context suffixes before applying value guidance, preferring the most trustworthy context.
Use the trust signal to reduce compounding drift and stabilize long-horizon decision-making.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this offers a practical way to make sequence-model-based control more robust over long horizons. It can improve rollout stability without requiring a separate trust estimator or major changes to the underlying Decision Transformer pipeline.
visual_elements: A rollout timeline showing prediction error increasing over time and signaling drift.
